name: Terracotta Zine
used_by: style S01 (engine/styles/S01-terracotta-zine.prompt.md): interiors bake from this template, Codex paints only the cover plate
vibe: Magazine collage / sticker layout / process explainer with terracotta texture bg
when_to_use: Step-by-step explainers and system builds (3-step systems, frameworks)
Text-heavier decks where a dense data-card layout would crowd the copy

placeholders.{{BRAND}}: meta strip; replaced with brand from engine/brand.json when the template is copied into a deck
placeholders.{{MONTH_YEAR}}: meta strip; replaced with the deck folder date's month and year, e.g. OCTOBER ©2026

assets.note: hero-placeholder.png marks where a capture goes; replace every use before the bake

structure.total_slides: variable (cover + N body + CTA); the sample is 9

cover.source: Codex cover plate from the SYSTEM and COVER blocks in engine/styles/S01-terracotta-zine.prompt.md; captures and logos composited into its key-color zones with shared/composite.py, never painted
cover.field: coverImg on slides[0], e.g. final/slide-01.png; empty renders a typographic preview

body.headline_treatment: lowercase massive Inter Black with accent-color phrase, 7 words or fewer
body.eyebrow_treatment: white text inside black brush-stroke badge, slight rotation
body.hero_treatment: real capture or rendered card as sticker: cream border + drop shadow + tape accents + slight tilt; empty heroImg hides it

cta.headline: big stacked line pointing at the comments
cta.body: Comment KEYWORD and I'll send you {the deliverable}. One action; save/follow/share asks go in the caption

tweaks.engine: localStorage keys namespaced by the page path (<path>::global-v1, <path>::slide-<name>-v1) + Export JSON button, synced by hand into slides[] defaults before the bake

heroes: optional illustrative HTML mocks in heroes/, /carousel renders only a deck's own heroes/ folder, never these samples
